findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env var FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE enters at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 (os.Getenv) -> returned by setting.GetFeishuFinanceAgentSetting() -> loaded as cfg in StartFeishuFinanceAgentWS at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:35 -> passed through runFeishuFinanceAgentWS into runFeishuFinanceAgentWSSession(cfg) -> feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain(cfg.OpenAPIBase) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:111-119 only trims trailing '/' and '/open-apis' with no scheme or host allowlist -> larkws.WithDomain(domain) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:102 -> sink: larkws.NewClient(cfg.AppID, cfg.AppSecret, opts...) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:105 followed by client.Start(context.Background()) at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:106, which dials the configured host and authenticates the long connection with the app credentials
Note: The outbound websocket/API destination is fully controlled by the FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE environment value and is not validated against a feishu.cn/larksuite.com allowlist; the SDK authenticates toward that domain using cfg.AppID/cfg.AppSecret, so a redirected or mistyped value sends the app credentials and all bot message/card traffic to an arbitrary host. Mitigation (recorded, does not break the path): the value comes from the deployment environment rather than an HTTP request, is unset by default (SDK then uses https://open.feishu.cn), and is documented for local smoke testing; note also that LLMBaseURL is a second env-controlled outbound endpoint but its HTTP sink (service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go) is not present in the supplied diff, so it is not rowed here.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Structural drift: placement
findings.body:
Standard: AGENTS.md#architecture (setting/)
Note: AGENTS.md defines setting/ as 'Configuration management (ratio, model, operation, system, performance)' — the gateway's documented config subdomains — and assigns environment-variable handling to common/ ('Shared utilities (JSON, crypto, Redis, env, ...)'). This new file adds a Feishu bot/agent integration configuration (app credentials, LLM base URL/key/model) populated entirely from FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_* environment variables, a concern outside the module's documented scope; whether env-sourced deployment-secret config belongs in setting/ or under common/ env utilities is a layer-placement question the doc does not cover.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with AGENTS.md#architecture (setting/).
